mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT mc.unit_cost FROM fin_material_cost mc WHERE mc.material_id = f.material_id AND mc.period <= f.period AND mc.unit_cost > 0 ORDER BY mc.period DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT SUM(pi.amount - pi.tax_amount) / SUM(pi.qty) FROM scm_trade_doc_item pi JOIN scm_trade_doc pd ON pd.id = pi.doc_id WHERE pi.material_id = f.material_id AND pd.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN'), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT d.biz_date AS biz_date, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) AS period, d.doc_no AS doc_no, d.partner_id AS customer_id, x.owner_id AS owner_id, i.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, d.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, d.dept_id AS dept_id, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END AS qty, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.amount - i.tax_amount ELSE i.tax_amount - i.amount END AS amount, 0 AS cost, 0 AS profit FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = d.partner_id WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN')
mapper.update: UPDATE bi_fact_sales f SET cost = ROUND(f.qty * , 2) WHERE f.id > 0
UPDATE bi_fact_sales SET profit = amount - cost WHERE id > 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.biz_date AS biz_date, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) AS period, d.doc_no AS doc_no, d.partner_id AS supplier_id, i.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, d.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END AS qty, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN i.amount - i.tax_amount ELSE i.tax_amount - i.amount END AS amount FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE d.kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN')

SELECT s.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, s.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = s.material_id GROUP BY s.warehouse_id, s.material_id, m.category HAVING SUM(s.qty) <> 0
mapper.update: UPDATE bi_fact_inventory f SET amount = ROUND(f.qty * , 2) WHERE f.snap_date = #{today}
mapper.select: SELECT w.wo_no AS wo_no, YEAR(COALESCE(w.plan_end, w.create_time)) * 100 + MONTH(COALESCE(w.plan_end, w.create_time)) AS period, w.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, w.dept_id AS dept_id, w.status AS status, w.qty AS plan_qty, w.finished_qty AS finished_qty, COALESCE(r.scrap_qty, 0) AS scrap_qty, COALESCE(r.hours, 0) AS hours, CASE WHEN w.plan_end IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN w.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') AND w.finish_time IS NOT NULL AND CAST(w.finish_time AS DATE) > w.plan_end THEN 1 WHEN w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND w.plan_end < #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late FROM mes_work_order w JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = w.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT wo_id, SUM(scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(hours) AS hours FROM mes_report GROUP BY wo_id) r ON r.wo_id = w.id WHERE w.status <> 'DRAFT'

SELECT v.period AS period, e.account_id AS account_id, a.category AS category, e.dept_id AS dept_id, SUM(e.debit) AS debit, SUM(e.credit) AS credit FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.source_type <> 'CLOSE' GROUP BY v.period, e.account_id, a.category, e.dept_id

SELECT t.dept_id AS dept_id, t.category AS category, SUM(t.headcount) AS headcount, SUM(t.hires) AS hires, SUM(t.leaves) AS leaves, SUM(t.gross_pay) AS gross_pay, SUM(t.labor_cost) AS labor_cost FROM ( SELECT e.dept_id, COALESCE(p.category, 'OTHER') AS category, CASE WHEN e.entry_date <= #{end} AND (e.leave_date IS NULL OR e.leave_date > #{end}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS headcount, CASE WHEN e.entry_date >= #{begin} AND e.entry_date <= #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hires, CASE WHEN e.leave_date >= #{begin} AND e.leave_date <= #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS leaves, 0 AS gross_pay, 0 AS labor_cost FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE e.entry_date <= #{end} AND (e.leave_date IS NULL OR e.leave_date >= #{begin}) UNION ALL SELECT i.dept_id, COALESCE(p.category, 'OTHER'), 0, 0, 0, i.gross_pay, i.gross_pay + i.social_company + i.housing_company FROM hr_payroll_item i JOIN hr_payroll r ON r.id = i.payroll_id JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = i.employee_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE r.period = #{period} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PAID') ) t GROUP BY t.dept_id, t.category

SELECT t.period AS period, t.owner_id AS owner_id, MAX(u.dept_id) AS dept_id, SUM(t.leads) AS leads, SUM(t.followups) AS followups, SUM(t.opps) AS opps, SUM(t.won) AS won, SUM(t.lost) AS lost, SUM(t.won_amount) AS won_amount FROM ( SELECT YEAR(create_time) * 100 + MONTH(create_time) AS period, owner_id, 1 AS leads, 0 AS followups, 0 AS opps, 0 AS won, 0 AS lost, 0 AS won_amount FROM crm_lead WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(follow_time) * 100 + MONTH(follow_time), create_by, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM crm_followup WHERE create_by IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(create_time) * 100 + MONTH(create_time), owner_id, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0 FROM crm_opportunity WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(close_date) * 100 + MONTH(close_date), owner_id, 0, 0, 0, CASE WHEN stage = 'WON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN stage = 'LOST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN stage = 'WON' THEN amount ELSE 0 END FROM crm_opportunity WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL AND close_date IS NOT NULL AND stage IN ('WON', 'LOST') ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.owner_id GROUP BY t.period, t.owner_id

SELECT t.period AS period, t.project_id AS project_id, p.dept_id AS dept_id, p.manager_id AS manager_id, SUM(t.hours) AS hours, SUM(t.labor_cost) AS labor_cost, SUM(t.expense) AS expense, SUM(t.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(t.cost) AS cost FROM ( SELECT YEAR(work_date) * 100 + MONTH(work_date) AS period, project_id, hours, cost AS labor_cost, 0 AS expense, 0 AS revenue, 0 AS cost FROM pm_timesheet WHERE status = 'APPROVED' UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(cost_date) * 100 + MONTH(cost_date), project_id, 0, 0, amount, 0, 0 FROM pm_cost WHERE status = 'APPROVED' UNION ALL SELECT period, project_id, 0, 0, 0, revenue, cost FROM pm_revenue ) t JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = t.project_id GROUP BY t.period, t.project_id, p.dept_id, p.manager_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_sales) AS "sales", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_purchase) AS "purchase", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_inventory) AS "inventory", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT snap_date) FROM bi_fact_inventory) AS "snapshots", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_production) AS "production", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_finance) AS "finance", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_hr) AS "hr", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_crm) AS "crm", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_project) AS "project"
